input: Find general day camps, Parks & Recreation camps, summer childcare, YMCA and Boys & Girls Club summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Arden, Fletcher, Skyland, Fairview and Mills River, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Arden Fletcher Mills River summer day camp 2026 YMCA parks recreation

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp included swimming, field trips, crafts, sports and nature activities.

candidates.name: Arden Seventh-day Adventist Church
candidates.note: FLAG Camp served ages 5–12 weekdays June 15–July 31, 2026.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers PreKamp and day camp for younger children plus overnight programs through grade 12.

candidates.name: Childcare Network
candidates.note: Full-day summer camp for ages 5–12; local centers on Sweeten Creek Road and Fairview Hills Drive.

candidates.name: Hahn's Gymnastics
candidates.note: Offers summer camps and summer childcare at 18 Legend Drive.

candidates.name: Veritas Christian Academy
candidates.note: Camp Veritas offered summer learning and activity programs in July 2026.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: 2027 day camps at FernLeaf's Wilderness Campus; also runs Brevard-area forest and backpacking camps.

candidates.name: Child Evangelism Fellowship of North Carolina
candidates.note: Camp Good News serves ages 7–16, including one day-camp week; confirmed summer 2026 operation.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Discovery, Explorer and Adventure day camps; Hendersonville Adventure Camp served ages 9–15 in 2026.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Provides summer youth-development programming at its Ashe Street clubhouse.

candidates.name: City of Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 youth day camps included Shiloh Community Center; also offered teen and specialty programs.

candidates.name: Town of Mills River Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Runs two summer tennis camps with Coach Dennis Harpell; welcomes all skill levels.
